name: vault-transcripts
description: Rename, clean, and summarize voice-note and meeting transcripts in an Obsidian vault inbox while preserving the original transcription verbatim.

tools.name: vault_transcripts
tools.description: Process raw transcripts in an Obsidian vault inbox: derive a dated descriptive filename, write schema-valid frontmatter, add a one-paragraph summary and a type-aware cleaned transcript, and keep the original transcription under a '# Transcript' heading; runs are dry-run by default and inspectable with status/doctor.
